question: In which of the following states is Saryu river located?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Uttarakhand**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Sarayu **originates from Lake Mansarovar in the Himalayas** and is also known as the Ghaghra and the Manas Nandini.
 
• Saryu is a major river draining the** Central Kumaon region** in the Indian state of Uttarakhand. 
 
• The length of the river is** 350 km**
 
• It merges with the Ganga in** Bihar's Saran district.**
 
• The Saryu river** tributaries** on the** Right side are Gomti, pannar** Lohar **Left side Ramganga and PUNGER.**
 
• The** Ayodhya** is located on the bank of the Sarayu river.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• ** Hooghly **river is the main river of West Bengal.
 
• **Sutlej **river is the main river of Himachal Pradesh.
 
• **Mahanad**i river is the main river of Chhattishgarh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
